reason: V3-03 repair: 4 must-fix findings remain on the WIP baseline. Four minor findings (direct adapter instantiation, Android Alert button limit, transient merged-order skew, 10k merge cap) should be addressed alongside. Coherent WIP delta preserved; next cycle must repair these specific gaps, not rebuild from scratch.
